name: contextlean
description: Audit and safely reduce avoidable context and configuration overhead in local AI agent environments.

interface.shortDescription: Measure and safely reduce Agent context overhead
interface.longDescription: A local-only, reversible Agent environment doctor for rules, Skills, plugins, hooks, and cross-vendor configuration. It audits first, applies only hash-guarded reviewed plans, verifies results, and supports rollback.
defaultPrompt: Audit this Agent environment and explain the highest-value safe optimizations.
Measure this repository's always-on context and prepare a reversible cleanup plan.
